Mom's Famous Chicken Soup 🍲

Ingredients:
- 1 whole chicken (3-4 lbs)
- 8 cups water
- 3 carrots, sliced
- 3 celery stalks, chopped
- 1 onion, diced
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 bay leaves
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley
- 2 cups egg noodles

Directions:
1. Place chicken in large pot with water
2. Bring to boil, then simmer 1 hour
3. Remove chicken, shred meat
4. Add vegetables to broth, cook 15 minutes
5. Return shredded chicken to pot
6. Add noodles, cook 8-10 minutes
7. Season with salt, pepper, parsley
8. Serve hot and enjoy!

Share if you love homemade soup! 💙
